The metal rings lack consistent mechanical logic; some appear to merge into the paper or spine without clear attachment points. Paper edges near the rings show slight melting/fusion artifacts.
The halftone dot pattern is irregular and warps slightly, lacking the precise geometric regularity of a printed image, suggesting generative texture noise.
